articles.articleText: What we know so far about Jensen Huang's affair with suspected Chinese spy - Published One of the Artificial Intelligence (AI) industry's most important figures has been accused of having an affair with a suspected Chinese spy, prompting an investigation. US intelligence officials believed that Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who had a close relationship with Nvidia CEO and co-founder Jensen Huang, was a spy for Beijing, according to a New York Times report. On Sunday, Huang admitted, external to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting her and their children. US tech giant Nvidia, one of the most valuable companies in the world, has opened an independent investigation into the reports. The firm said it does not believe US national security had been compromised - and added that Huang was committed to continuing to lead the company. President Donald Trump said on Monday that the FBI is also investigating the affair. The FBI declined to comment further when contacted by the BBC. Trump said he spoke with Huang on Monday following reports that the US believed he had been targeted in a Chinese espionage campaign. "I asked him that question, 'Did you have any idea she was a spy?' He said 'I had no idea she was a spy' and I really believe him," Trump told reporters. Here is what we know about the affair and why it matters. - Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy - Published1 hour ago - Zoe Kleinman: Nvidia CEO's affair will cause ripples across US and beyond - Published7 hours ago Who is Alice Huang and what do we know about the affair? US officials believed that Alice Huang had been recruited to spy by China's top intelligence agency, the New York Times reported, external. Her current whereabouts are unknown. Alice Huang, who is of no relation to Jensen Huang, was a top executive at Singapore-based data centre firm Megaspeed between March and November 2023. The firm had been suspected of helping divert Nvidia chips to China, a concern that Nvidia maintains was investigated and debunked. However, Megaspeed is under investigation by the Singapore government regarding previous allegations that the company was circumventing US sanctions on the export of Nvidia's high-end chips. The BBC has contacted Megaspeed for comment. The company told the New York Times last month its current leadership took the allegations seriously and had appointed external legal advisers to conduct an internal investigation. Surveillance reportedly revealed communications between Alice Huang and an American citizen, who was subsequently identified as Jensen Huang through a process known as "unmasking". It remains unclear what, if any, intelligence Alice Huang – who is also known as Huang Le – allegedly gathered and passed to Beijing. She did not respond to the paper's request for comment. When the BBC asked Nvidia if the company was aware of intelligence concerns, the company said it was not. "We trust that if we were the target of a genuine threat, the US government would have notified us," an Nvidia spokesperson told the BBC. China has rejected the spying allegations. Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun told reporters on Monday at a regular daily press briefing: "We have already responded to this. The allegations about Chinese spies are entirely groundless, speculative and intended to smear and malign China." The New York Times reported in late October that Trump had been briefed last year on intelligence alleging Alice Huang was spying on China's behalf. Asked by reporters on Sunday whether he wished he had "acted on the intelligence", Trump responded: "No, I don't think so. I think he's an honourable guy." US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, meanwhile, refused to comment when asked about Huang. Last spring, the secretary of state reportedly oversaw the drafting of a memo that warned the Trump administration about Huang's relationship with the Chinese businesswoman, according to the New York Times. Why does it matter? Nvidia is at the heart of US and China's AI race, which is why the billionaire's affair has sparked national security fears among American lawmakers. Trump has said "whoever wins AI wins", and the fear is that if China gains the upper hand in AI, it will supercharge the country's military and surveillance capabilities. The US advantage is in large part because of US companies like Nvidia, working with producers like the Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), which makes more than 90% of the world's most advanced chips. Since 2022, the US has used various export controls to keep the top tech out of China, which it says helps retain America's competitive edge and protects its national security. This means companies like Nvidia have been largely locked out of the world's most lucrative market, with Huang once saying that Nvidia's share of the Chinese market had gone from around 95% to effectively zero. Huang has engaged in shuttle diplomacy between Washington and Beijing, hoping to find a US-approved way back in, and shaping US policy on China along the way. Sunday's revelations may explain why Huang has failed to bring home the biggest prize of all to Nvidia: the Trump administration's blessing to sell all but its most advanced chips to China. Who is Jensen Huang? Born in Taiwan in 1963, Huang was nine years old when his family moved to the West Coast of the US. He graduated as an electrical engineer from Oregon State University, and then with a master's degree in the same field from Stanford University. Huang then worked at US chip firm AMD before co-founding Nvidia. Known as "Daddy Huang" in Taiwan and once lauded as the "Taylor Swift of tech", he has a reputation as a workaholic and perfectionist with incredibly high standards for his staff. He has an estimated fortune of $155bn (£115bn), according to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index. "Jensen Huang is a tech visionary of the likes of Steve Jobs," Stephen Witt, the author of Thinking Machine, a biography on Huang, told the BBC, adding that he was responsible for creating AI hardware as we know it today. Huang has a famously close relationship with Trump. At the recent AI summit at the White House, where 42 tech executives were present, the president was flanked by Elon Musk and Huang. Trump said he had not spoken to the Nvidia boss since news of the investigation emerged. "I just know he's a fine person, but you never know what's going on," Trump told reporters, adding that he had "done an amazing job for our country". What is Nvidia and how important is it? Founded by Huang and fellow electrical engineers Chris Malachowsky and Curtis Priem in 1993, the company was originally known for chips that process graphics, particularly for computer games. Eventually it changed focus to AI, a field it now dominates. Huang rescued Nvidia from bankruptcy on more than one occasion, and took risks on AI a long time before the rest of the world did, effectively building the infrastructure from scratch. "Today when we think of that, we think of these giant data centres - none of that existed. There were no customers for the stuff he was building. In fact his first customer was Open AI at the time they had 30 people - he actually gave it to them, he donated it to them," Witt told the BBC. Every notable tech company building AI tools and infrastructure, including Amazon, Meta, Google, and Microsoft, now use Nvidia chips. Currently worth $4.5tn (£3.4tn), Nvidia is one of the most valuable companies ever. For now, the firm's board appears to have little appetite for removing Huang, saying in a statement on Sunday that they have "confidence in Jensen and his leadership team". Sources tell the BBC his removal is unlikely because there is so much money at stake. There is no public succession plan for the 63-year-old. He has often said he hopes to continue in the role for decades, and Bloomberg reports he has created an informal leadership structure around him unlike a traditional company's hierarchy. His children, Spencer and Madison, and son-in-law Nico Caprez work at Nvidia in senior roles. Who is Jensen Huang's wife? Huang met his future wife Lori Mills at Oregon State University while studying electrical engineering in the early 1980s. The pair were lab partners. They married in 1985, about eight years before he co-founded Nvidia, and have two children, Madison and Spencer. In 2007, the couple founded the Jen-Hsun and Lori Huang Foundation. The charitable fund has seen its assets surge in recent years, driven by the soaring value of Nvidia shares, and is estimated to be worth more than $9bn. Its donations include tens of millions of dollars to engineering programmes at Oregon State and Stanford University. Witt told the BBC that Huang has gone to great lengths to present himself as a family man, adding: "That's very important to him". "He praises his wife, he talks about her in very glowing ways," he added. "The fallout of this would be bad for anyone's family. But for someone who has gone to such great lengths to cultivate an image of being a family guy and who keeps his children very close, it is very bad." Additional reporting by Tom McArthur in London, Ayeshea Perera and Tessa Wong in Singapore and Helen Davidson in Sydney - Published21 September

His children, Spencer and Madison, and son-in-law Nico Caprez work at Nvidia in senior roles. Who is Jensen Huang's wife? Huang met his future wife Lori Mills at Oregon State University while studying electrical engineering in the early 1980s. The pair were lab partners. They married in 1985, about eight years before he co-founded Nvidia, and have two children, Madison and Spencer. In 2007, the couple founded the Jen-Hsun and Lori Huang Foundation. The charitable fund has seen its assets surge in recent years, driven by the soaring value of Nvidia shares, and is estimated to be worth more than $9bn. Its donations include tens of millions of dollars to engineering programmes at Oregon State and Stanford University. Witt told the BBC that Huang has gone to great lengths to present himself as a family man, adding: "That's very important to him". "He praises his wife, he talks about her in very glowing ways," he added. "The fallout of this would be bad for anyone's family. But for someone who has gone to such great lengths to cultivate an image of being a family guy and who keeps his children very close, it is very bad." Additional reporting by Tom McArthur in London, Ayeshea Perera and Tessa Wong in Singapore and Helen Davidson in Sydney - Published21 September

articles.title: Judge denies motion to dismiss Lindsay Clancy's murder case
articles.summary: The ruling means the case can move forward, possibly with reduced charges in a new trial.

articles.titleTr: Judge denies motion to dismiss Lindsay Clancy's murder case
articles.summaryTr: The ruling means the case can move forward, possibly with reduced charges in a new trial.
articles.articleText: Judge denies motion to dismiss Lindsay Clancy's murder case - Published A Massachusetts judge has denied a motion to dismiss the murder case against Lindsay Clancy, the US woman accused of killing her three children. The judge's ruling follows her defence team's request to dismiss the case after the 12-person jury in her September trial failed to reach a verdict. Clancy has not denied killing her children in 2023, but her defence team argues she was suffering from severe postpartum psychosis at the time. Prosecutors say the killings were intentional. The ruling clears the way for prosecutors to pursue the case. They could reduce the charges in a potential second trial or dismiss them altogether. Clancy's defence team argued to dismiss the case against her due to double jeopardy - a legal standard that prevents a person from being tried for the same crime twice. Her lawyers argued that Judge William Sullivan, who presided over the 26-day jury trial last summer, acted prematurely when he declared a mistrial on 4 September, saying that he should have sought a viable alternative. The five-week trial, its lead-up and aftermath gripped Americans, and put postpartum mental health issues such as psychosis in the spotlight. In his ruling on Monday, Sullivan said that a retrial would not unconstitutionally subject Clancy to double jeopardy, according to court documents obtained by the BBC. The possibility that "an unreasonably stubborn or eccentric juror" could be seated is "an unavoidable risk of the jury system", he said. "Because the court concludes that there was manifest necessity for a mistrial based on the jury's deadlock, a retrial on the murder indictments does not violate Clancy's right not to be placed in double jeopardy." Sullivan also denied a defence motion to see records of the lone holdout juror in the case and to question the juror under oath. He said the defence failed to demonstrate that the records were needed for Clancy's defence at any retrial, and that questioning the juror "would have been impermissibly coercive". The judge has marked 16 November to discuss scheduling a potential second trial. He previously suggested it could begin in March. The BBC has contacted Clancy's lawyers for comment. Prosecutors in the closely watched case alleged that on 24 January 2023, Clancy intentionally strangled all of her children - Cora, 5, Dawson, 3, and Callan, eight months - in their Duxbury, Massachusetts, home. After weeks of emotional testimony, the jury took a week to deliberate, repeatedly telling the judge that they could not reach a verdict. The deadlock stemmed from a lone juror who voted to convict Clancy of first-degree murder, while the 11 other jurors intended to acquit Clancy by reason of insanity. In Massachusetts, as well as in all US criminal murder trials, juries must reach a unanimous decision to convict or acquit a defendant. Because the jurors failed to unanimously agree on whether the prosecution had proved Clancy was guilty "beyond a reasonable doubt" as required by US law, the judge declared a mistrial on 4 September, which means that she was neither found guilty nor not guilty. Clancy is currently being housed in a state-run psychiatric hospital and medical facility in Massachusetts. Ana Faguy contributed reporting.

articles.articleText: Dana White declines Trump’s offer to be White House press secretary Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC) boss Dana White declined President Donald Trump's offer to be the next White House press secretary during a briefing on Monday. The president had asked White to take over the role in a social post over the weekend. Trump later said he was "having a little fun". During the briefing, White confirmed he won't take the job as he doesn't "want to be in politics."

articles.summaryTr: ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, İran'a yönelik askeri müdahalenin şu an için gerekli görünmediğini söyledi. Trump, koşulların değişmesi halinde ABD ordusunun harekete geçmeye hazır olduğunu belirtti.
articles.articleText: Trump'tan İran açıklaması: "Şu aşamada askeri müdahale gerekli görünmüyor" YAYIN TARİHİ, 10 Kasım 2026 01:26 PAYLAŞ - ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, İran'a yönelik askeri müdahalenin şu an için gerekli görünmediğini söyledi. Trump, koşulların değişmesi halinde ABD ordusunun harekete geçmeye hazır olduğunu belirtti. ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, İran'la yaşanan çatışmaya ilişkin yaptığı açıklamada, şu aşamada ABD'nin askeri müdahalede bulunmasına gerek olmadığını düşündüğünü söyledi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle 9 Kasım Pazartesi günü gazetecilerin sorularını yanıtlayan Trump, "Bu noktada askeri harekât çok gerekli bir şey gibi görünmüyor. Ancak herhangi bir nedenle koşullar değişirse harekete geçmeye hazırız" ifadelerini kullandı. "Çatışmanın yakında sona ereceğini düşünüyorum" Trump, Tahran yönetimiyle yaşanan çatışmanın seyrine ilişkin de değerlendirmede bulundu. ABD Başkanı, "Bunun oldukça yakında sona ereceğini düşünüyorum" dedi. Trump'ın açıklamaları, Washington yönetiminin İran'a yönelik askeri seçenekleri tamamen dışlamadığını, ancak mevcut koşullarda doğrudan müdahaleyi gerekli görmediğini ortaya koydu.

articles.title: ABD'den İsrail'e para musluğu kapanıyor! Rubio'dan dikkat çeken açıklama
articles.summary: ABD Dışişleri Bakanı Marco Rubio, İsrail'in finansal açıdan yeterli seviyeye ulaştığını belirterek Washington yönetiminin Tel Aviv'e artık finansman sağlamasına gerek kalmadığını söyledi. İki ülke arasında yeni bir savunma mutabakatı üzerinde görüşmeler sürüyor.

articles.titleTr: ABD'den İsrail'e para musluğu kapanıyor! Rubio'dan dikkat çeken açıklama
articles.summaryTr: ABD Dışişleri Bakanı Marco Rubio, İsrail'in finansal açıdan yeterli seviyeye ulaştığını belirterek Washington yönetiminin Tel Aviv'e artık finansman sağlamasına gerek kalmadığını söyledi. İki ülke arasında yeni bir savunma mutabakatı üzerinde görüşmeler sürüyor.
articles.articleText: ABD'den İsrail'e para musluğu kapanıyor! Rubio'dan dikkat çeken açıklama - ABD Dışişleri Bakanı Marco Rubio, İsrail'in finansal açıdan yeterli seviyeye ulaştığını belirterek Washington yönetiminin Tel Aviv'e artık finansman sağlamasına gerek kalmadığını söyledi. İki ülke arasında yeni bir savunma mutabakatı üzerinde görüşmeler sürüyor. ABD Dışişleri Bakanı Marco Rubio, Fransa'nın başkenti Paris'te düzenlenen G7 Dışişleri Bakanları toplantısının ardından yaptığı açıklamada, ABD'nin İsrail'e yönelik askeri finansman politikasında değişikliğe gidilebileceğinin sinyalini verdi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Rubio, ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın beklentisinin İsrail'in artık kendi finansmanını karşılayabilecek ekonomik güce ulaştığı yönünde olduğunu belirtti. Rubio, "Başkanın beklentisi, İsrail'in artık yeterince refah düzeyine ve zenginliğe ulaştığı, dolayısıyla sadece 'satış' modeline geçebileceği yönünde. Bizden silah alabilir ama artık finansman sağlamamız gerekmiyor. Zaten bu, bizzat İsrail tarafının bize önerdiği bir husus" dedi. ABD ile İsrail arasında yeni savunma anlaşması görüşmeleri ABD ve İsrail'in yeni bir mutabakat zaptı üzerinde müzakereler yürüttüğünü aktaran Rubio, İsrail'in de kendi silahlarını ürettiğine dikkat çekti. Rubio, iki ülkenin bazı savunma kalemlerinde ortak üretim modeline geçebileceğini ifade etti. Rubio'dan Hegseth'e destek Rubio, ABD Savunma Bakanı Pete Hegseth'in görevden alınabileceğine ilişkin iddialar hakkında da konuştu. Hegseth'in İran'la savaşı destekleyen isimlerden biri olduğu yönündeki değerlendirmeler ve Trump'ın kendisini görevden almayı düşündüğü iddiaları hatırlatılan Rubio, savunma bakanına destek verdi. Rubio, Hegseth'in görevinde "çok iyi iş çıkardığını" düşündüğünü söyledi. Yapay zekanın ekonomik etkilerine dikkat çekti Rubio, yapay zekanın sağladığı fırsatların yanı sıra güvenlik ve ekonomi alanlarında ciddi riskler barındırdığını belirtti. Yapay zekanın biyolojik ve kimyasal silah üretiminde, siber saldırılarda ve terör eylemlerinde kullanılabileceğine ilişkin endişelerini dile getiren Rubio, teknolojinin iş gücü üzerindeki etkilerine de dikkat çekti. Rubio, yapay zekanın ekonomik faydalar sağlayacağını ancak bazı sektörleri ve çalışanları devre dışı bırakma potansiyeli bulunduğunu söyledi. Küresel kurumların yapay zekanın gelişimini yavaşlatacak düzenlemeler arayışında olduğunu savunan Rubio, bu yaklaşımdan endişe duyduğunu ve doğru bulmadığını ifade etti.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.summaryTr: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
articles.articleText: Here’s what happened in crypto today Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation. Today in crypto, Elliptic said North Korean hackers used memecoins to launder funds stolen in the Binance hack, EU authorities asked the finance industry to develop common standards for tokenized securities, and Zcash developers proposed cutting block times from 25 to 20 seconds. North Korean hackers create memecoins to launder funds from Binance hack: Elliptic North Korean hackers created memecoins to launder cryptocurrency stolen in the $6.3 billion Binance hack, routing roughly $430,000 through six newly launched tokens on the NEAR blockchain, according to a report from blockchain analytics firm Elliptic. Between Nov. 5 and 7, the hackers created at least six tokens on NEAR and used liquidity pools on decentralized exchanges to move stolen funds between wallets, Elliptic said. The tokens attracted almost no outside trading and were abandoned shortly after launch. The hackers used one set of wallets to swap stolen NEAR tokens for the new memecoins, then used another set to sell those memecoins back into the pools for NEAR. The swaps let them move funds without direct wallet-to-wallet transfers, though the transactions remained traceable onchain. Elliptic said the same laundering technique was also used following the $1.5 billion Bybit hack in 2025, when North Korean-linked actors moved at least $24 million through a newly created token on the TRON blockchain. EU taps industry to set standards for tokenized securities The European Central Bank, European Commission and European Securities and Markets Authority are seeking nominations for an industry-led group that will draft common standards for holding and settling tokenized securities. Eligible applicants include EU industry associations, global institutions, private firms and fintech companies. They can apply to the European Tokenisation Standards Group (ETSG) by Nov. 27, with work set to begin in January 2027, according to a release published Monday. The three EU institutions will participate as observers. The group will develop technical and market standards to help companies hold and settle tokenized securities across different distributed ledger technology (DLT) platforms and ensure those platforms can work with existing financial systems. The group aims to produce an initial set of standards by early 2028, according to its mandate. The standards will support Appia, the Eurosystem’s initiative to develop a blueprint for Europe’s tokenized financial markets. The institutions warned that fragmentation could limit the benefits of tokenization and said the group may recommend ways for EU authorities to encourage firms to adopt its standards. In September, the Eurosystem launched Pontes, a system that allows financial institutions to settle wholesale transactions in tokenized assets in central bank money. Zcash devs propose another block time cut days after NU7 upgrade Zcash developers have proposed reducing the blockchain’s target block interval from 25 seconds to 20 seconds, seeking faster transaction confirmations days after activating the NU7 upgrade. On Sunday, developers ValarDragon and Evan Forbes submitted a draft Zcash Improvement Proposal (ZIP) on GitHub, saying that they want the change to be included in the next community poll and considered for the upcoming NU7.1 network upgrade. The reduction would shorten the expected wait for initial transaction confirmations. According to the proposal, this would improve the user experience for point-of-sale payments, exchange deposits and cross-chain swaps. The developers said the change would not increase the network’s overall daily capacity for private transactions. The proposal would also preserve Zcash’s existing issuance schedule, despite blocks being produced more frequently. The proposal comes just days after Zcash’s NU7 upgrade went live. On Friday, the NU7 upgrade was activated on the mainnet, cutting the network’s target block interval from 75 seconds to 25 seconds. The upgrade also introduced a Network Sustainability Mechanism designed to recycle a portion of transaction fees into future mining rewards while preserving Zcash’s 21 million ZEC supply cap.

EU taps industry to set standards for tokenized securities The European Central Bank, European Commission and European Securities and Markets Authority are seeking nominations for an industry-led group that will draft common standards for holding and settling tokenized securities. Eligible applicants include EU industry associations, global institutions, private firms and fintech companies. They can apply to the European Tokenisation Standards Group (ETSG) by Nov. 27, with work set to begin in January 2027, according to a release published Monday. The three EU institutions will participate as observers. The group will develop technical and market standards to help companies hold and settle tokenized securities across different distributed ledger technology (DLT) platforms and ensure those platforms can work with existing financial systems. The group aims to produce an initial set of standards by early 2028, according to its mandate. The standards will support Appia, the Eurosystem’s initiative to develop a blueprint for Europe’s tokenized financial markets. The institutions warned that fragmentation could limit the benefits of tokenization and said the group may recommend ways for EU authorities to encourage firms to adopt its standards. In September, the Eurosystem launched Pontes, a system that allows financial institutions to settle wholesale transactions in tokenized assets in central bank money. Zcash devs propose another block time cut days after NU7 upgrade Zcash developers have proposed reducing the blockchain’s target block interval from 25 seconds to 20 seconds, seeking faster transaction confirmations days after activating the NU7 upgrade. On Sunday, developers ValarDragon and Evan Forbes submitted a draft Zcash Improvement Proposal (ZIP) on GitHub, saying that they want the change to be included in the next community poll and considered for the upcoming NU7.1 network upgrade. The reduction would shorten the expected wait for initial transaction confirmations. According to the proposal, this would improve the user experience for point-of-sale payments, exchange deposits and cross-chain swaps. The developers said the change would not increase the network’s overall daily capacity for private transactions. The proposal would also preserve Zcash’s existing issuance schedule, despite blocks being produced more frequently. The proposal comes just days after Zcash’s NU7 upgrade went live. On Friday, the NU7 upgrade was activated on the mainnet, cutting the network’s target block interval from 75 seconds to 25 seconds. The upgrade also introduced a Network Sustainability Mechanism designed to recycle a portion of transaction fees into future mining rewards while preserving Zcash’s 21 million ZEC supply cap.

Şirket; enflasyon muhasebesi, ertelenmiş vergi, PDVSA alacağının kırdırılması ve amortisman giderlerinin zararda etkili olduğunu bildirdi. Çan2 Termik A.Ş. (CANTE), 2026 yılı üçüncü çeyrek finansal sonuçlarını Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'nda (KAP) açıkladı. Şirket, 1 Ocak-30 Eylül 2026 döneminde 3 milyar 792 milyon 199 bin 979 TL net zarar kaydetti. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Geçen yılın aynı döneminde 3 milyar 885 milyon 288 bin 42 TL zarar açıklayan şirketin dokuz aylık zararında sınırlı bir gerileme yaşandı. Üçüncü çeyrekteki net zarar ise 731 milyon 729 bin 19 TL oldu. CANTE zararının nedenlerini açıkladı Çan2 Termik, KAP'a yaptığı açıklamada dönem zararını etkileyen gider kalemlerine ilişkin bilgi verdi. Şirket, 30 Eylül 2026 itibarıyla 369 milyon 534 bin 100 TL FAVÖK ve 447 milyon 114 bin 995 TL net finansman geliri elde ettiğini bildirdi. Şirket, PDVSA alacağının kırdırılmasından kaynaklanan gider hariç olmak üzere, operasyonel olmayan ve nakdi/gayrinakdi risk içermeyen TFRS'ye uygun muhasebe kayıtlarının dönem zararını önemli ölçüde etkilediğini belirtti. Açıklanan gider kalemleri şöyle sıralandı: - Enflasyon muhasebesinden kaynaklanan zarar: 1 milyar 68 milyon 886 bin 155 TL - Ertelenmiş vergi gideri (VUK-TFRS farklılıkları): 910 milyon 252 bin 469 TL - PDVSA alacağının kırdırılmasından kaynaklanan gider: 1 milyar 726 milyon 663 bin 601 TL - Amortisman gideri: 1 milyar 95 milyon 959 bin 9 TL Bu kalemlerin toplamı 4 milyar 801 milyon 761 bin 234 TL'ye ulaştı. Şirket, söz konusu giderlerin finansal tablolardaki kâr/zarar kalemini önemli ölçüde etkilediğini ve 3 milyar 792 milyon 199 bin 979 TL ana ortaklık dönem zararının oluştuğunu açıkladı. PDVSA alacağı neden kırdırıldı? Şirketin açıklamasında, bağlı ortaklığı Denarius Pumping Services de Venezuela'nın Venezuela devlet petrol şirketi Petróleos de Venezuela S.A. (PDVSA) nezdindeki alacaklarına da değinildi. Söz konusu alacağın, Çan2 Termik'in Denarius'a iştirak etmesinden önceki döneme ait olduğu belirtildi. PDVSA'nın eski yükümlülüklerini yerine getirmemesi nedeniyle alacaklar için karşılık ayrılması yerine alacağın kırdırıldığı ve bu işlem sonucunda şirkete nakit girişi sağlandığı ifade edildi. Satışlar artarken faaliyet kârı negatife döndü Çan2 Termik'in satış gelirleri, 2026'nın ilk dokuz ayında geçen yılın aynı dönemine göre yüzde 4 artarak 6 milyar 139 milyon 116 bin 64 TL'ye yükseldi. Geçen yılın aynı döneminde satışlar 5 milyar 922 milyon 241 bin 278 TL seviyesindeydi. Esas faaliyet zararı ise 476 milyon 509 bin 690 TL'den 1 milyar 127 milyon 915 bin 912 TL'ye yükseldi. FAVÖK, geçen yılın ilk dokuz ayındaki 2 milyar 184 milyon 979 bin TL seviyesinden 536 milyon 939 bin TL'ye geriledi. Varlıklar ve özkaynaklar geriledi 30 Eylül 2026 itibarıyla şirketin toplam varlıkları 35 milyar 777 milyon 262 bin 515 TL oldu. 2025 yıl sonunda bu rakam 38 milyar 449 milyon 437 bin 121 TL seviyesindeydi. Toplam borçlar 2 milyar 687 milyon 664 bin 48 TL'den 2 milyar 801 milyon 958 bin 171 TL'ye yükselirken, özkaynaklar 34 milyar 727 milyon 65 bin 722 TL'den 32 milyar 729 milyon 178 bin 118 TL'ye geriledi. Şirketin piyasa değeri 10,29 milyar TL, PD/DD oranı ise 0,31 olarak kaydedildi.

articles.articleText: Astor Enerji'de (ASTOR) kar beklentisi tersine döndü: İşte şirketin 3. çeyrek bilançosu - Astor Enerji, 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğinde 3,17 milyar TL net zarar açıkladı. Şirketin 1,16 milyar TL'lik ortalama kâr beklentisine karşılık zarar etmesinde, 3,70 milyar TL'lik yatırım faaliyeti zararı etkili oldu. Astor Enerji A.Ş. (ASTOR), 2026 yılı üçüncü çeyrek finansal sonuçlarını 9 Kasım 2026 tarihinde Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'nda (KAP) açıkladı. Şirket, yılın üçüncü çeyreğinde 3 milyar 176 milyon 124 bin 858 TL net zarar kaydetti. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Matriks Haber tarafından düzenlenen bilanço anketine katılan 5 kurumun Astor Enerji için ortalama net kâr beklentisi 1 milyar 163 milyon 100 bin TL, medyan beklentisi ise 622 milyon TL seviyesindeydi. Şirket, kâr beklentilerinin aksine milyarlarca liralık zarar açıkladı. Yatırım faaliyetlerinden 3,7 milyar TL zarar Astor Enerji'nin üçüncü çeyrekte açıkladığı zararda yatırım faaliyetlerinden kaynaklanan 3 milyar 704 milyon 609 bin 274 TL'lik zarar etkili oldu. Şirket, 1 Ocak-30 Eylül 2026 döneminde toplam 1 milyar 677 milyon 318 bin 569 TL net kâr açıkladı. Geçen yılın aynı döneminde 6 milyar 174 milyon 499 bin 575 TL net kâr elde edilmişti. Böylece dokuz aylık net kâr yıllık bazda yüzde 73 geriledi. Satışlar ve faaliyet kârı arttı Şirketin satış gelirleri, 2026'nın ilk dokuz ayında geçen yılın aynı dönemine göre yüzde 16 artarak 33 milyar 622 milyon 133 bin 145 TL'ye yükseldi. 2025'in ilk dokuz ayında satışlar 28 milyar 875 milyon 710 bin 773 TL seviyesindeydi. Borçlar yükseldi, özkaynaklar geriledi 30 Eylül 2026 itibarıyla Astor Enerji'nin toplam varlıkları 75 milyar 313 milyon 904 bin 731 TL oldu. 2025 yıl sonunda bu rakam 63 milyar 9 milyon 474 bin 750 TL seviyesindeydi. Toplam borçlar 21 milyar 636 milyon 539 bin 175 TL'den 34 milyar 438 milyon 845 bin 42 TL'ye yükseldi. Özkaynaklar ise 41 milyar 372 milyon 935 bin 575 TL'den 40 milyar 875 milyon 59 bin 689 TL'ye geriledi. Şirketin özkaynakları çeyreklik dönemde yüzde 12 azaldı. articles.titleTr: CEO hakkındaki soruşturma yatırımcıyı kaçırdı: Nvidia hisselerinde yüzde 7'yi aşan düşüş!
articles.summaryTr: Nvidia hisseleri, CEO Jensen Huang'ın yabancı istihbarat faaliyetinin hedefi olduğuna ilişkin iddialar sonrası başlatılan bağımsız soruşturmanın etkisiyle yüzde 7'yi aşan düşüşle açıldı. Hisseler daha sonra 175,9 dolara kadar geriledi.
articles.articleText: CEO hakkındaki soruşturma yatırımcıyı kaçırdı: Nvidia hisselerinde yüzde 7'yi aşan düşüş! - Nvidia hisseleri, CEO Jensen Huang'ın yabancı istihbarat faaliyetinin hedefi olduğuna ilişkin iddialar sonrası başlatılan bağımsız soruşturmanın etkisiyle yüzde 7'yi aşan düşüşle açıldı. Hisseler daha sonra 175,9 dolara kadar geriledi. ABD'li çip üreticisi Nvidia'nın hisseleri, şirketin kurucusu ve CEO'su Jensen Huang hakkında gündeme gelen iddiaların ardından sert satış baskısıyla karşılaştı. Nvidia Yönetim Kurulu'nun bağımsız soruşturma başlatma kararı, yatırımcıların şirket yönetimine ilişkin endişelerini artırdı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Hisseler haftanın ilk işlem gününe yüzde 7'nin üzerinde kayıpla başladı. Türkiye saatiyle 19.30 itibarıyla Nvidia hisseleri yüzde 5'in üzerinde düşüşle 175,9 dolardan işlem gördü. Alice Huang hakkındaki iddialar soruşturmayı tetikledi ABD ile Çin arasında yapay zeka alanındaki küresel liderlik rekabeti sürerken, Jensen Huang'ın Çinli iş insanı Alice Huang ile yakın ilişkisi bulunduğu ve Alice Huang'ın Pekin yönetimine bilgi aktardığı yönündeki iddialar gündeme geldi. The New York Times'ta yayımlanan haberde, Jensen Huang'a yakın olduğu belirtilen Çinli iş kadını Alice Huang'ın Pekin yönetimine istihbarat amacıyla bilgi aktardığı öne sürüldü. Bu iddiaların ardından Nvidia Yönetim Kurulu, CEO Jensen Huang'ın yabancı istihbarat faaliyetinin hedefi olduğuna ilişkin haberleri incelemek üzere bağımsız soruşturma başlatacağını duyurdu. Huang soruşturmayla işbirliği yapacak Jensen Huang, çalışanlarına gönderdiği mesajda eşiyle ilişkisi konusunda sadık kalmadığını kabul ederken, yönetim kurulunun başlattığı bağımsız soruşturmayı desteklediğini açıkladı. Soruşturma sürecinde tam işbirliği yapacağını belirten Huang, "Nvidia'yı korumaya ve ABD'nin ulusal güvenliğini desteklemeye kararlıyım" ifadelerini kullandı. Soruşturmanın sonuçları ve Huang'ın CEO olarak görevine devam edip etmeyeceğine ilişkin belirsizlikler, yatırımcıların odağında bulunuyor.

articles.title: Should you leave Australia to avoid paying 47% tax on crypto gains?
articles.summary: Some Australian crypto investors are moving overseas to avoid the huge CGT increase from July 2027. But there are also less drastic ways you can pay less tax.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Should you leave Australia to avoid paying 47% tax on crypto gains?
articles.summaryTr: Some Australian crypto investors are moving overseas to avoid the huge CGT increase from July 2027. But there are also less drastic ways you can pay less tax.
articles.articleText: Should you leave Australia to avoid paying 47% tax on crypto gains? Some Australian crypto investors are moving overseas to avoid the huge CGT increase from July 2027. But there are also less drastic ways you can pay less tax. In part one of our special on how to avoid Australia’s massive hike in capital gains taxes on crypto in July next year, we looked at borrowing against your Bitcoin or setting up a self-managed super fund (SMSF), among four ways to mitigate the impact of the taxes. While an SMSF offers Australians the greatest tax advantages, it’s only suitable for older investors, or those who are willing to lock up their crypto for decades until they retire. For younger investors, moving overseas could reduce your future crypto tax bills to 0% — but there are less drastic options to save on tax too. 5. Leave Australia and move to country with 0% CGT Australia’s impending tax changes have already inspired crypto king Fred Schebesta, founder of Finder.com, to become a tax exile in Singapore. From July, the top rate on real, long-term crypto gains will increase to 47%, minus the effects of inflation on the cost basis. For upwardly mobile, single crypto investors, the “nuclear option” of leaving the country to avoid giving almost half their gains to the government will look increasingly attractive. Many of the world’s top crypto hubs — Singapore, Portugal, Malta, UAE and Hong Kong — offer 0% capital gains taxes on long-term crypto gains in an attempt to attract wealthy investors. Also read: The one thing these 6 global crypto hubs all have in common...Should you leave Australia to avoid paying 47% tax on crypto gains? Ben Simpson, founder of crypto advisory service Collective Shift, says some of his members have already pulled the trigger. “Yeah, we’ve had a number of people that have sort of packed up and gone basically, ‘f—- this. I’m off to the Bahamas or whatnot,’” he says. Andrea Yuen, CEO of Sywftx, says she is keenly aware of the tax advantages of living outside of Australia. “I lived in Singapore for 30 years. I do miss my no capital gains tax,” she says. But she didn’t move there for tax reasons, and cautions that uprooting your life to avoid a bit of tax is a pretty drastic step. “I would never say that we should structure our lives only to think about tax outcomes,” she says. “There are many other wonderful reasons why I’ve come back to Australia and continued to live in Australia.” “I think if you’re moving countries solely based on a decision about whether you know your crypto is going to get taxed, then you probably need to think a little bit harder.” Simpson has considered the idea, given he already spends half the year in America looking after Collective Shift US, but looking into the rules put him off. “You really have to cut pretty much all ties to Australia. So if you are genuinely happy to leave and don’t want to come back for the majority of the year, and cut your healthcare and cut all your ties back to Australia, then that is a strategy.” “Bitcoin Jesus” Roger Ver gave up his US residency in 2014, and ten years later he was arrested and charged over failing to correctly report the value of his crypto holdings and paying exit taxes. He was forced to pay almost $50 million to make the case go away. Similarly, Australians leaving the country face a hefty exit tax on departure, which may require selling a decent amount of your stack. “They tax you on the way out. If you’ve got a lot of gains or profits you’re sitting on, they’ll catch you when you leave,” says Adrian Forza, director of Crypto Tax Australia. “Arguably it’d be bigger in the future, but it’s still difficult to stomach selling off everything to leave.” Forza explains you also have the option of paying the Australian taxes later on, but on the full value of the gain after you sell the asset. So if you expect Bitcoin to go up, you’d be best off paying the exit tax now. Related: Australia releases draft bill to adopt OECD crypto tax reporting framework 6. Set up a company to benefit from the company tax rate Simpson is only 27 and the prospect of locking up his crypto portfolio for forty years holds little appeal. Instead, he trades and holds crypto via a company to benefit from the 25% company tax rate. Running a single-person company is easier than you might think, but not worth the hassle unless you have a reasonable amount of capital and intend to make a lot of trades. It requires registering the company with ASIC and paying an annual fee, paying an accountant to produce financial statements and/or an annual company tax return and mucking about with payroll software and payday superannuation contributions if you plan to pay yourself an income. You can pay yourself a dividend at any time when you need some money. “The company structure is good if you’re wanting to cap the capital gains tax at the company tax rate,” he says, but notes there’s a big catch: when you take funds out of the company, you need to pay the difference between the 25% company tax rate and your personal tax rate. “You still need to pay your marginal income tax rates. If you’re on the top tax rate, like 47%,” he says. You may be wondering: if you have to pay your income tax rate anyway, which will equal the CGT rate from July, what is the benefit in paying a few thousand dollars and filling out a bunch of paperwork to run a company? Simpson explains that the key advantage is that while you are building up your crypto portfolio by trading in and out of different coins, you only pay the 25% company rate for each sale. That means paying up to 22% less than CGT each time you exit a position, which builds into an even more significant saving over time. “Instead of paying 47% because you’ve just taken the profits… then the CGT amount is only 25% — the company tax rate. So when you put that money back in, you’ve got more capital to play with.” However, if you don’t trade enough, it might be taxed at 30%. Forza says the advantages are greater for those on higher incomes. “If you’re a single person, then you’ve got a company, and you’re earning, you know, 150 grand a year, um, or over 200, then yeah, definitely a company would be the way to go, especially now that the CGT discount has gone out the window.” It’s not a particularly useful structure if you just plan to just hold your Bitcoin, however. There are some potential advantages but arguably not enough of them to be worth the hassle. 7. Just get out of crypto entirely to avoid high CGT rates The 50% CGT discount has been replaced by an indexation discount, which takes into account how much inflation affects how much you paid originally for an asset. This means that investors who buy and hold dividend stocks or index funds for a long period will receive a bigger CGT discount. So should you drop crypto and buy a bunch of ETFs so you can pay less tax? The short answer is no: the new CGT ‘discount’ is largely an illusion, as it simply measures your real gain after inflation. Simpson says crypto has been hit hard by the CGT changes, but it still offers the best risk-reward opportunity. “For us in Bitcoin, the growth ... heavily outweighs the tax considerations. In my point of view. If you’ve got the right portfolio, that can give you the right upside.” History suggests that despite volatility and years-long bear markets, the return from investing in Bitcoin over time would still leave investors ahead of ETF investors even after paying more tax. Investing further down the risk curve with altcoins however, can either pay off handsomely or end in total disaster. JPMorgan assumes that Bitcoin will compound by 10% on average in the years ahead. (Source JPMorgan/Bitcoin Archive) Simpson says he convinced his younger sister, who is a basketball player on a low income, to invest in Bitcoin two years ago rather than putting money into a savings account. “She’s up like 40% or 50% in her portfolio and she’s like, ‘wow, this is going to get me so much further towards buying a house one day than sitting in cash and losing 10% [to inflation over time],” he says. “That’s why I think Bitcoin makes so much sense to accumulate. And the tax considerations are not really there for most people I think.” Yuen says crypto is one of the few asset classes that offers investors the chance to make double-digit returns in a few months, or to potentially double their money. Even after paying the new taxes, crypto investors with those sorts of returns will still be ahead. “My dad always said to me, it’s a good thing, if you’ve made profits, you should be happy to pay some tax on it.” Well maybe not happy about it, but you’ll still be making money. Also read: How Aussie Bitcoiners can avoid 2027’s shock CGT hike, Part 1

articles.title: North Korean hackers create memecoins to launder funds from Binance hack: Elliptic
articles.summary: The blockchain firm traced stolen funds through six new tokens on NEAR, where hackers used liquidity pools to obscure transfers between wallets.

articles.titleTr: North Korean hackers create memecoins to launder funds from Binance hack: Elliptic
articles.summaryTr: The blockchain firm traced stolen funds through six new tokens on NEAR, where hackers used liquidity pools to obscure transfers between wallets.
articles.articleText: North Korean hackers create memecoins to launder funds from Binance hack: Elliptic The blockchain firm traced stolen funds through six new tokens on NEAR, where hackers used liquidity pools to obscure transfers between wallets. North Korean hackers created memecoins to launder cryptocurrency stolen in the $6.3 billion Binance hack, routing roughly $430,000 through six newly launched tokens on the NEAR blockchain, according to a report from blockchain analytics firm Elliptic. Between Nov. 5 and 7, the hackers created at least six tokens on NEAR and used liquidity pools on decentralized exchanges to move stolen funds between wallets, Elliptic said. The tokens attracted almost no outside trading and were abandoned shortly after launch. The hackers used one set of wallets to swap stolen NEAR tokens for the new memecoins, then used another set to sell those memecoins back into the pools for NEAR. The swaps let them move funds without direct wallet-to-wallet transfers, though the transactions remained traceable onchain. How stolen NEAR moved between wallets through liquidity pools. Source: Elliptic Elliptic also found that five of the six token creators were funded with proceeds from earlier token sales just two to 13 minutes before the next launch, linking the tokens in a chain of transactions. “North Korea’s launderers rarely rely on a single technique,” Elliptic co-founder Tom Robinson wrote in the report. “Instead, they layer many cheap techniques, each adding a little more delay.” Elliptic said the same laundering technique was also used following the $1.5 billion Bybit hack in 2025, when North Korean-linked actors moved at least $24 million through a newly created token on the TRON blockchain. At the time of Elliptic’s analysis, about 11.8 million NEAR stolen in the Binance hack remained unmoved. Elliptic valued those funds at $43.7 million. Magazine: Vitalik ‘pivots’ ETH to store of value, crypto suffers after US midterms: Hodler’s Digest

articles.title: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
articles.articleText: Release Number 9324-26 CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers November 09, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced eight orders filing and settling charges against Michael Talento, Anthony Tyler Williams, Quillan Roberto Black, Christopher Williams, Michael Levi Peters, Jordan Taylor Morgan, Lewis Matthew Neal, and Tyler Evan MacKechnie for acting as unregistered associated persons of unregistered foreign introducing brokers. According to the orders, the introducing brokers engaged in the solicitation of orders for off-exchange leveraged or margined retail foreign currency and retail commodities transactions with U.S. customers who were not eligible contract participants. The respondents solicited those customers without registering as associated persons of the introducing brokers, as required. Under the orders, the respondents must cease and desist from engaging in their illegal conduct. They also are barred for two years from registering with the Commission in any capacity or acting as a principal, agent, or employee of any CFTC registrant. Each order also recognizes the penalty the respondent owes in a related Securities and Exchange Commission proceeding. These orders relate to a prior Commission order sanctioning Netrios LP Ltd. and Red Acre Ltd. for facilitating illegal off-exchange commodity transactions with U.S. customers. [See CFTC Press Release No. 9263-26] The SEC has filed and settled charges against the respondents based on the same underlying conduct. The CFTC thanks the SEC for its assistance. -CFTC-

articles.title: Formation Securities plans Solana stock trading venue under SEC exemption
articles.summary: The proposed venue would offer 24/7 trading of tokenized shares from Galaxy Digital, Exodus and Forward Industries, with a launch planned for early 2027.

articles.titleTr: Formation Securities plans Solana stock trading venue under SEC exemption
articles.summaryTr: The proposed venue would offer 24/7 trading of tokenized shares from Galaxy Digital, Exodus and Forward Industries, with a launch planned for early 2027.
articles.articleText: Formation Securities plans Solana stock trading venue under SEC exemption The proposed venue would offer 24/7 trading of tokenized shares from Galaxy Digital, Exodus and Forward Industries, with a launch planned for early 2027. Formation Securities, a newly established company licensing technology from decentralized exchange Orca, has notified the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) of plans to launch a tokenized stock trading venue on Solana in early 2027. The company said Monday that tokenized shares of Galaxy Digital, Exodus Movement and Forward Industries are expected to be available at launch. The venue would operate under the SEC’s temporary Innovation Exemption announced in September, which allows verified investors to trade certain US-listed shares around the clock while retaining voting, dividend and other shareholder rights. Superstate and Securitize are expected to make tokenized shares available on the marketplace, which Formation says it intends to develop in cooperation with public companies. The venue would use automated market maker (AMM) technology, allowing investors to hold securities in their own wallets and settle trades onchain against stablecoins and other eligible assets. Traditional transfer agents would continue to maintain official shareholder records, preserving companies’ direct relationships with shareholders. Solana is already among the largest blockchains for tokenized equities, with approximately $575 million in tokenized stock value as of Monday, compared with $747 million on Ethereum and $1.7 billion on BNB Chain, according to RWA.xyz data. Related: Robinhood’s Tenev warns US tokenization uncertainty deters ‘serious assets’ Tokenized stock plans draw issuer concerns Formation’s issuer-focused approach comes amid growing debate over how publicly traded shares should be brought onchain. As of early November, more than 50 companies had objected to having their shares tokenized on OKXICE, a proposed venue backed by crypto exchange OKX and New York Stock Exchange parent Intercontinental Exchange. Under the SEC’s Innovation Exemption, trading venues must notify issuers in writing and wait at least 30 calendar days before trading shares tokenized by unaffiliated third parties, giving companies an opportunity to object. Nasdaq warned in September that tokenized stock trading could have unforeseen consequences for liquidity, price discovery and long-term shareholder value. Solana is already among the largest blockchains for tokenized equities, with approximately $575 million in tokenized stock value as of Monday, compared with $747 million on Ethereum and $1.7 billion on BNB Chain, according to RWA.xyz data. Related: Robinhood’s Tenev warns US tokenization uncertainty deters ‘serious assets’ Tokenized stock plans draw issuer concerns Formation’s issuer-focused approach comes amid growing debate over how publicly traded shares should be brought onchain. As of early November, more than 50 companies had objected to having their shares tokenized on OKXICE, a proposed venue backed by crypto exchange OKX and New York Stock Exchange parent Intercontinental Exchange. Under the SEC’s Innovation Exemption, trading venues must notify issuers in writing and wait at least 30 calendar days before trading shares tokenized by unaffiliated third parties, giving companies an opportunity to object. Nasdaq warned in September that tokenized stock trading could have unforeseen consequences for liquidity, price discovery and long-term shareholder value. articles.summary: The pilot lets eligible corporate and institutional clients accept USDC on Ethereum, with each token converted to one US dollar before deposit.

articles.titleTr: PNC Bank tests turning USDC payments into dollar deposits
articles.summaryTr: The pilot lets eligible corporate and institutional clients accept USDC on Ethereum, with each token converted to one US dollar before deposit.
articles.articleText: PNC Bank tests turning USDC payments into dollar deposits The pilot lets eligible corporate and institutional clients accept USDC on Ethereum, with each token converted to one US dollar before deposit. PNC Bank, the eighth-largest US bank by assets, launched a limited pilot enabling eligible corporate and institutional clients to receive USDC payments through Coinbase. The pilot accepts USDC, a US dollar-backed stablecoin issued by Circle, on Ethereum using Coinbase Payments products. Payments are automatically converted into dollars and deposited into designated PNC accounts, allowing businesses to accept stablecoins without holding them. PNC said the service aims to speed up access to funds and improve cross-border payment efficiency. The bank did not disclose fees, settlement-time benchmarks or the number of participating clients, nor did it respond to Cointelegraph’s request for additional details by publication time. The pilot builds on a partnership established in July 2025, when PNC agreed to offer cryptocurrency services through Coinbase’s infrastructure while providing banking services to the exchange. The partnership led to the launch of Bitcoin (BTC) trading for eligible PNC Private Bank clients in December. PNC’s move follows a similar initiative by Citi, which expanded its Coinbase partnership in September to enable institutional clients to accept stablecoin payments through its Spring by Citi platform, with Coinbase converting the payments into fiat currency. USDC is the second-largest stablecoin by market capitalization, at $70.5 billion, behind Tether’s USDT at $176.8 billion, according to DefiLlama data. The total stablecoin market stood at around $290.8 billion on Monday. Magazine: Vitalik ‘pivots’ ETH to store of value, crypto suffers after US midterms: Hodler’s Digest

articles.title: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
articles.articleText: Release Number 9323-26 CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today issued an interpretation (“Interpretation”) of the requirement that designated contract markets (“DCMs”) provide competitive, open, fair, and impartial access to their members and persons with trading privileges under Commission Regulation 38.151(b) (“Impartial Access Requirements”). “Derivatives markets must operate on a uniform basis at a national scale in order to achieve the purposes set out in the Commodity Exchange Act,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Geographic access restrictions are inconsistent with those purposes and the Act’s impartial access requirements.” DCMs must cease domestic geographic restrictions that violate the Impartial Access Requirements within 30 days, or else submit to the Division of Market Oversight (“Division”) an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. Further, within 30 days, DCMs should ensure that intermediaries accessing their markets are not impeding and are complying with the DCM’s Impartial Access Requirements, or else submit to the Division an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. The Commission will consider the facts and circumstances of any particular case in connection with potential Commission action. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
articles.articleText: Release Number 9321-26 CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets November 04, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the U.S. Department of Agriculture today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to safeguard the integrity of U.S. agricultural markets. The MOU will allow the CFTC and USDA to harmonize policies and practices to better share information and increase access to risk management tools. The agreement will also assist both agencies with monitoring and identifying structural or potential systematic risks, among other things. “For decades, America’s agricultural community has relied on our markets to hedge risk, manage uncertainty, and plan for the future,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “I’m proud that the CFTC and USDA have formalized this partnership through an MOU that will strengthen protections for America’s farmers, ranchers, and producers while expanding opportunities to manage risk through more efficient data sharing. I commend Secretary Rollins for her partnership and commitment to a more coordinated regulatory approach that safeguards the integrity of our markets and ensures they continue serving the agricultural community that feeds and clothes our nation.” “Faster and more transparent data sharing between USDA and CFTC is critical to helping our farmers and ranchers navigate an ever-changing market,” said USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins. “This MOU builds upon USDA’s ongoing data modernization efforts and allows our agencies to collaboratively identify risks and improve responses to market events. Breaking down barriers between government agencies to deliver for our customers is a hallmark of this administration and I am looking forward to the successes this MOU will bring.” -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
articles.articleText: Release Number 9320-26 CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas entered a default judgment against defendants Walter Dunning Larrick III and Cambridge Financial Advisors LLC for their participation in a commodities fraud scheme. In entering the default judgment, the court found the defendants fraudulently solicited and misappropriated more than $3 million from participants. The court found the defendants falsely represented they would use participant funds to trade futures and options, including those involving natural gas, oil, and gold; made material misrepresentations and omissions about the profitability of commodity trading with them; and issued false account statements to conceal their misconduct. The court further found the defendants misappropriated participant funds by making payments to existing participants in a manner akin to a Ponzi scheme, paying Larrick’s personal expenses, and sending funds to offshore accounts in Costa Rica. The court ordered the defendants to pay a $9,767,625 civil monetary penalty and $3,255,875 in restitution. It also permanently enjoined them from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission regulations, as charged, and imposed permanent trading and registration bans. The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2023 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 8768-23.] -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
articles.articleText: Release Number 9319-26 CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig today released a statement announcing that perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities can begin trading for the first time on designated contract markets that are dually registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission as notice-registered national securities exchanges to trade security futures products. Key excerpts from Chairman Selig’s statement: “Today, perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities (the ‘Equity Perps’) can begin trading for the first time on CFTC-registered exchanges. … “This expansion marks a significant step towards allowing U.S. market participants, consistent with applicable law, to avail themselves of the advantages of perpetual futures that have led to their emergence as widely sought tools for risk-management and price-discovery. I believe that bringing these types of innovative products into our regulated markets ensures that American investors and traders can access these products within the protections of the CFTC’s proven regulatory framework, rather than being forced to turn to offshore, and often unregulated, venues. … “The Equity Perps build on the foundation of the [Commodity Futures Modernization Act of 2000] and the [CFTC-SEC Memorandum of Understanding]. For too long, regulatory uncertainty left innovative products, such as security futures and equity perpetual futures, stranded in what SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins has aptly described as a regulatory ‘no man’s land’ due to a lack of harmonization between the agencies. The CFTC and SEC have turned the page on that era, and are committed to delivering regulatory clarity for innovative products and a clear path to market, rather than more casualties of jurisdictional disputes.” Read Chairman Selig’s full statement here. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
articles.articleText: Release Number 9318-26 CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading October 28, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced it will host an industry roundtable Dec. 15 to discuss issues related to the viability of derivatives markets moving to 24/7 trading. The dialogue will build upon the CFTC’s Request for Comment earlier this summer on 24/7 trading. The CFTC’s roundtable will provide a public venue for dialogue on the evolving market structures shaping derivatives markets, including overnight trading, tokenization, infrastructure and staffing needs, and operational readiness. Participants will convene from across the industry to discuss how the Commission can promote responsible innovation while protecting market participants and preserving the integrity and resilience of U.S. derivatives markets. “I have been consistently clear: under my leadership, the CFTC will not take a one‑size‑fits‑all approach to 24/7 trading. Market structure evolves best through thoughtful and responsible progress, and that’s exactly why we’re hosting a roundtable to hear directly from industry on their views for 24/7 trading across different asset classes,” Chairman Selig said. The roundtable will take place at CFTC’s headquarters in Washington. Information regarding the agenda, speakers, and registration will be posted at a later date. This event will be open to the public and livestreamed on CFTC.gov. Please note the number of in-person participants may be limited, and visitors will be subject to security checks. Members of the public are welcome to submit speaker nominations to [email protected]. -CFTC-

articles.title: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
articles.articleText: Release Number 9317-26 ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — Last week, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the Risk Management Center at Kansas State University co-hosted the 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon) in Overland Park, Kansas. The two-day conference brought together industry leaders, policymakers, and market participants to examine critical issues facing the agricultural economy, developments in derivatives markets, and the risk management tools American farmers, ranchers, and agribusinesses depend on. Conference Highlights CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig joined K-State President Richard Linton to welcome participants on opening day. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig addressed conference attendees, “I have spent a lot of time this year traveling around the country and talking to farmers and ranchers working hard each day to provide the food, feed, and fiber we depend on throughout our country and the world. I’ve met with farmers, ranchers, agribusinesses, and energy producers in Iowa, Texas, Nebraska, South Carolina, and Florida, and now, I’m with all of you here in Kansas.” [Watch Chairman Selig’s full remarks here.] Following Chairman Selig’s remarks, panelists examined the relationship between cash and derivatives markets, evolving commodity contracts, and the importance of effective hedging tools for agricultural producers. There were also panels where industry representatives addressed access to agricultural credit and the financial challenges facing producers and merchants. Additional afternoon discussions focused on rising production costs, fluctuating commodity prices, supply chain disruptions, and broader pressures on the farm economy. In addition, conference participants engaged in discussions about emerging market developments, including perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral, and their implications for agricultural risk management. CFTC Chief Advisor Alex Titus and White House Council of Economic Advisers Member Aaron Hedlund also examined the U.S. economic outlook, agricultural trade, and policies shaping American agriculture. The first day concluded with a keynote address from U.S. Department of Agriculture Deputy Secretary Stephen Vaden. U.S. Senator Roger Marshall of Kansas opened the second day with a morning keynote address on agricultural policy and legislative priorities facing American producers. The morning continued with discussions on agricultural prediction markets, the use of data in modern commodity markets, and developments in event contracts. In addition, panelists examined superintelligence, information advantages, and market integrity, including the implications of emerging technologies for market participants and regulators. Chairman Selig joined Futures Industry Association President and CEO Walt Lukken for a fireside chat examining the Commission’s priorities, the evolving regulatory landscape, and developments shaping derivatives markets. The conference concluded with discussions on enhancing public understanding of markets through data and customer education, followed by a panel examining clearing, market access, and the role of intermediaries in derivatives markets. Chairman Selig delivered closing remarks, concluding AgCon2026. -CFTC-

In addition, conference participants engaged in discussions about emerging market developments, including perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral, and their implications for agricultural risk management. CFTC Chief Advisor Alex Titus and White House Council of Economic Advisers Member Aaron Hedlund also examined the U.S. economic outlook, agricultural trade, and policies shaping American agriculture. The first day concluded with a keynote address from U.S. Department of Agriculture Deputy Secretary Stephen Vaden. U.S. Senator Roger Marshall of Kansas opened the second day with a morning keynote address on agricultural policy and legislative priorities facing American producers. The morning continued with discussions on agricultural prediction markets, the use of data in modern commodity markets, and developments in event contracts. In addition, panelists examined superintelligence, information advantages, and market integrity, including the implications of emerging technologies for market participants and regulators. Chairman Selig joined Futures Industry Association President and CEO Walt Lukken for a fireside chat examining the Commission’s priorities, the evolving regulatory landscape, and developments shaping derivatives markets. The conference concluded with discussions on enhancing public understanding of markets through data and customer education, followed by a panel examining clearing, market access, and the role of intermediaries in derivatives markets. Chairman Selig delivered closing remarks, concluding AgCon2026. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report
articles.articleText: Release Number 9316-26 CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig announced the CFTC’s plan to increase the publication frequency of the Commitments of Traders Report (COT Report) from once to twice a week by the end of 2026. Data from Monday will be published on Wednesday, and data from Wednesday will be published on Friday. Both reports will be released at 3:30 p.m. ET on their respective publication days. Under the enhanced publication schedule, the reports’ latency will decrease from three days to two days. The change follows the Commission’s recent Request for Comment and reflects its commitment to providing market participants with more timely information about trading positions and activity in agricultural markets. The CFTC’s Division of Data is leading the effort to operationalize the expanded publication schedule through modernization and automation while maintaining accuracy. “COT Reports have been an important source of transparency for decades. Following feedback from the agricultural community, I’m pleased to announce the CFTC will be rolling out COT Reports twice a week to ensure this information stream is as useful as possible,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. -CFTC-

news.summary: Avustralyalı havayolu devi Qantas Airways, teknoloji ve yapay zeka alanında Accenture ile anlaşma imzaladı. Anlaşma kapsamında yaklaşık 850 çalışanın işine son verilmesi planlanırken, ilk işten çıkarmaların 2027 ortasına kadar gerçekleşmesi bekleniyor.

news.articleText: Havayolu devi yapay zeka için imzayı attı: 850 kişi işten çıkarılacak - Avustralyalı havayolu devi Qantas Airways, teknoloji ve yapay zeka alanında Accenture ile anlaşma imzaladı. Anlaşma kapsamında yaklaşık 850 çalışanın işine son verilmesi planlanırken, ilk işten çıkarmaların 2027 ortasına kadar gerçekleşmesi bekleniyor. Avustralya'nın en büyük havayolu şirketi Qantas Airways, dijital dönüşüm sürecini hızlandırmak için küresel danışmanlık şirketi Accenture ile anlaşma imzaladı. Teknoloji ve yapay zeka odaklı iş birliğinin, şirketin Avustralya'daki yaklaşık 28 bin çalışanının yüzde 3'ünü etkilemesi bekleniyor. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Qantas CEO'su Vanessa Hudson, müşterilere ve çalışanlara daha entegre hizmet sunabilmek ve yenilikleri hızlandırabilmek için şirketin operasyonel süreçlerini, teknoloji platformlarını ve veri altyapısını yeniden yapılandırması gerektiğini belirtti. Hudson, Accenture'ın havacılık sektörü dahil büyük ölçekli şirketlerin dijital dönüşüm süreçlerinde uluslararası deneyime sahip olduğunu vurguladı. İlk işten çıkarmalar 2027'de Anlaşma kapsamında işten çıkarmaların birkaç yıla yayılması, ilk aşamanın ise 2027 yılının ortasına kadar gerçekleşmesi öngörülüyor. Accenture'a devredilecek işlerin büyük bölümünün Hindistan'daki, kalan kısmının ise Avustralya'daki ekipler tarafından yürütülmesi planlanıyor. Söz konusu süreçlerin ilerleyen dönemde otomasyon ve yapay zeka teknolojileriyle dönüştürülmesi hedefleniyor.

news.title: Brent petrol düştükçe düşüyor: Demokratlar "dönüm noktası" tarihini belirledi
news.summary: Brent petrol, ABD Başkanı Trump’ın İran’a yeni bir müdahaleyi düşünmediğini açıklamasının ardından düşüşünü sürdürerek Ağustos sonundan beri en düşük seviyesine indi. ABD’de Demokratların savaşı sona erdirmek için siyasi baskı aracı olarak hükümet kapanması tarihini değerlendirdiği belirtildi.

news.titleTr: Brent petrol düştükçe düşüyor: Demokratlar "dönüm noktası" tarihini belirledi
news.summaryTr: Brent petrol, ABD Başkanı Trump’ın İran’a yeni bir müdahaleyi düşünmediğini açıklamasının ardından düşüşünü sürdürerek Ağustos sonundan beri en düşük seviyesine indi. ABD’de Demokratların savaşı sona erdirmek için siyasi baskı aracı olarak hükümet kapanması tarihini değerlendirdiği belirtildi.
news.articleText: Brent petrol düştükçe düşüyor: Demokratlar "dönüm noktası" tarihini belirledi Brent petrol, ABD Başkanı Trump’ın İran’a yeni bir müdahaleyi düşünmediğini açıklamasının ardından düşüşünü sürdürerek Ağustos sonundan beri en düşük seviyesine indi. ABD’de Demokratların savaşı sona erdirmek için siyasi baskı aracı olarak hükümet kapanması tarihini değerlendirdiği belirtildi. Petrol fiyatlarında düşüş ikinci güne taşındı Petrol fiyatları, önceki seansta yaşanan kayıpların ardından salı günü de geriledi. Trump’ın İran’a karşı şu aşamada yeni bir askeri müdahaleye gerek olmadığını belirtmesi, Orta Doğu’daki arz kesintilerinin uzun süre devam edeceği endişelerini azalttı. Brent petrol vadeli işlemleri yüzde 1’i aşan düşüşle varil başına 91,50 dolara, WTI vadeli işlemleri ise 85,80 dolara indi. Ham petrol fiyatlarındaki gerileme, enerji maliyetleri üzerinden enflasyon baskılarının hafiflemesine ve merkez bankalarının ilave para politikası sıkılaştırmasına duyulan ihtiyacın azalmasına zemin hazırlayabilir. Trump, İran’a yönelik saldırıları erteleme planını açıkladı ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, pazartesi günü yaptığı açıklamada, bölge ülkelerinin talepleri doğrultusunda İran’a yönelik yeni askeri saldırıları şimdilik ertelemeyi planladığını söyledi. Trump, Katar Başbakanı’nın Beyaz Saray’daki görüşmeler sırasında yaptığı çağrıların da bu kararda etkili olduğunu belirtti. Trump, Reuters’a verdiği röportajda ve daha sonra Beyaz Saray’da düzenlenen basın toplantısında, Hürmüz Boğazı’ndaki deniz ablukasını ise şimdilik sürdürmeyi planladığını ifade etti. Piyasa Trump’ın daha uzlaşmacı tutumuna odaklandı KCM Trade Baş Piyasa Analisti Tim Waterer, piyasanın ABD ara seçimlerinden bu yana Trump’ın İran politikasındaki daha uzlaşmacı yaklaşımını önceliklendirdiğini söyledi. Waterer, Hürmüz Boğazı çevresindeki gemilere yönelik saldırıların devam ettiğini ancak bu saldırıların piyasaya yeni bir risk primi ekleyecek ölçüde tırmanmadığını belirtti. Brent petrol, 30 Ekim’de ulaştığı altı aylık zirve olan 118 dolardan yaklaşık yüzde 22 geriledi. ABD ara seçimlerinin ardından Trump’ın İran’a yönelik saldırıları artırabileceği endişelerinin azalması, fiyatlardaki düşüşte etkili oldu. Bununla birlikte, Hürmüz Boğazı’ndaki gelişmeler nedeniyle deniz taşımacılığının aksayabileceğine ilişkin endişeler devam ediyor. Kongre’deki Demokratların da Trump’ı savaşı sona erdirmeye zorlamak amacıyla 11 Aralık’taki hükümet kapanması tarihini kullanmayı değerlendirdiği belirtiliyor. 90 doların altı için kalıcı gerilim azalması gerekiyor Eurasia Group Kıdemli Analisti Gregory Brew, son satışlara rağmen Brent petrolün varil başına 90 doların altına gerilemesinin, gerilimin kalıcı biçimde azaldığına ilişkin daha güçlü işaretler ve ABD-İran anlaşması olmadan zor göründüğünü belirtti. Brew, İran’ın Hürmüz Boğazı’ndan geçen gemilere yönelik saldırılarını sürdürmesi nedeniyle denizcilik sektörüne ilişkin risklerin yüksek kalmaya devam ettiğini ifade etti. Rusya ve Ukrayna arasında ABD arabuluculuğunda görüşme planı Rus ve Ukraynalı yetkililerin, salı günü ABD arabuluculuğunda iki gün sürecek görüşmeler için bir araya gelmesi planlanıyor. Bu temaslar, şubat ayından bu yana iki ülke arasında yapılması planlanan ilk görüşmeler olacak. Görüşmelerin gündeme gelmesinde, Trump’ın geçen hafta yaklaşık 4,5 yıldır devam eden savaş için geniş kapsamlı bir barış anlaşmasının mümkün olduğunu ve böyle bir anlaşmanın Avrupa’nın güvenliğini de kapsayabileceğini söylemesi etkili oldu. Petrol piyasasının gözü EIA, OPEC ve IEA raporlarında Yatırımcılar, küresel petrol arzı ve talebine ilişkin daha kapsamlı değerlendirme yapabilmek için ABD Enerji Bilgi İdaresi (EIA), Petrol İhraç Eden Ülkeler Örgütü (OPEC) ve Uluslararası Enerji Ajansı’nın (IEA) aylık piyasa raporlarını bekliyor. Reuters anketine göre OPEC’in petrol üretimi ekim ayında arttı. Üretim artışına Suudi Arabistan, Kuveyt ve Irak öncülük ederken, petrol ihracatına yönelik kısıtlamalar devam etti.
